note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry, Release 103 (September 2026), the column for Croatia. A national check inside the BBAN, where the country has one, isn't in the registry and isn't modelled: a number drawn here passes the IBAN's own check. Until 2026-11-03 this file read the registry's copy in GNU Taler's iban-tools (its latest country update December 2024), the only one reachable on 2026-10-30.

sources.title: SWIFT, IBAN Registry (ISO 13616), Release 103 (September 2026), its text release (iban-registry_2.txt), read from Common Crawl's capture of 2026-10-06 because swift.com answered 403 ('SWIFT site off-line') on 2026-11-03; every country's structure, positions, length and example checked against the release's PDF (https://www.swift.com/sites/default/files/files/iban-registry_4.pdf, Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2026-43, captured 2026-10-15)
